specimens.label: KnownSynthetic
specimens.description: Synthetic Dummie VEC statement — Jul–Ago 2025 period
specimens.notes: First synthetic fixture. NOT a compliant statement — fails typography, section structure, and legend rules. Used only to exercise pipeline mechanics, never as compliance evidence.

allowedFails.reason: Omitted reference-data: movement dates vs. period — synthetic fixture may have transactions outside the bundle period range; not a PDF defect.

knownFixtureDefects.reason: Fixture PDF pagination labels do not match document page count — inherent synthetic generator limitation.
Fixture PDF card number absent from some pages — inherent synthetic generator limitation.
Fixture PDF uses non-Aptos embedded fonts — synthetic generator does not embed Aptos; this is a genuine typography non-compliance.
Fixture PDF body text measured at 5.04 pt (word '11', page 1) — genuinely below the 8 pt floor. Synthetic generator emits small-size page-header numbers. Not a false rule.
Fixture PDF section gap geometry is non-standard — mandatory sections appear out of order or with non-standard spacing in the synthetic layout.
Fixture PDF is missing mandatory CONDUSEF sections (e.g. §2–§5, §9, §10, §14, §15) — genuine structural non-compliance of the synthetic generator.
Fixture PDF §13 Transferencia content is absent — genuine missing section content in the synthetic generator output.
Fixture PDF §17 mandatory verbatim legends are absent — genuine missing legends; not the same as catalog text mismatch.
Fixture PDF §18 benefit program completeness check fails — section content incomplete in the synthetic generator output.
Fixture PDF §20 payment distribution waterfall is absent — genuine missing content in synthetic generator output.
Fixture PDF §26 Notas Aclaratorias content is absent — genuine missing section content in the synthetic generator output.
Fixture PDF §27 Glosario content is absent — genuine missing section content in the synthetic generator output.
